svg.title: C4 Container View — SaludDeUna
svg.desc: C4 Level 2 diagram showing the main containers: Next.js web, Expo mobile, NestJS API, MongoDB, Redis, Gemini AI
svg.text: Stack: NestJS 11 (API) · Next.js 16 (Web) · Expo 54 (Mobile) · MongoDB Atlas 7 · Redis Cloud · Google Gemini 2.5
Protocolo: REST + WebSocket (Socket.IO) · JWT HS256 + RS256 · Rate Limit 20 req/60s
